verdict.rationale: Controls over AI training on user data are a fair question for an AI app-building service, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documentation of a training opt-out, data-usage setting, or privacy guarantee for Figma Make. The one community mention of 'training' is about how the underlying model was trained on code, not about user data controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
